verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client, and official SDKs are a fair thing for a SaaS product of this kind to offer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an official SDK. MCP client integrations and Zapier connections are adjacent features, not SDKs, and probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
